newsitem.title: USA: Rainforest Cafe COO resumes duties.
newsitem.headline: Rainforest Cafe COO resumes duties.

text.p: Rainforest Cafe Inc said Monday its president and chief operating officer Martin O'Dowd has resumed his duties after a 30-day personal leave of absense.
In November, Rainforest Cafe said O'Dowd would take a 30-day leave, and Lyle Berman, chairman and chief executive, as well as other senior management, would fulfill his duties until his return.
O'Dowd said Monday the company's 1997 development schedule includes seven domestic projects and two international locations.
Rainforest Cafe develops, owns and operates combination restaurant/retail facilities.
